m: रप् (cf. √ लप्) cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xi, 7) रपति (pf. रराप &c. Gr.), to talk, chatter, whisper, RV. : Intens. रारपीति id., ib.
a: रप् — {c1c} P. (रपति) 1 To speak distinctly. --2 Ved. To praise.

m: रप्श् (only occurring in the pr.p. below and in प्र- and वि-√ रप्श्q.v.), to be full, RV.
रप्शद्-ऊधन् mfn. having a full or distended udder, RV. ii, 34, 5.

s: vade । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰saka॰-sew .) rapati । vadaH kaTanam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: vyaktavAkye BvA॰ pa॰ saka॰ sew । rapati arApIt arapIt rarApa repatuH ।

m: रपस् n. (cf. रेपस् fr. √ रिप्) bodily defect, injury, infirmity, disease, RV.; VS. (accord. to Sāy. also = रक्षस्).
a: रपस् — n. Ved. 1 Defect, fault. --2 Sin. --3 Injury, harm.

m: र—प्रत्याहार m. N. of a partic. Pratyāhāra (q.v.)
रप्सु = रूप, Mahīdh. on VS. xxxiii, 19.
रप्सुदा f. du. (of unknown meaning), RV. viii, 72, 12.
